```plato

    // True when `point` lies inside the closed ring, by the even-odd (crossing
    // number) rule: inside when the ray towards +X crosses an odd number of edges.
    // Exact for a simple (non-self-intersecting) ring; for a self-intersecting one
    // it reports the even-odd region rather than the non-zero-winding region.
    // Points exactly ON the boundary are not classified reliably — the strict `<`
    // in EdgeCrossesRay makes the answer depend on floating point, so callers that
    // need a boundary guarantee must test the boundary separately.
    // https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Point_in_polygon
    PolygonContainsPoint(points: Array<Point2D>, point: Point2D): Boolean
        => points.Count
            .MapRange(i => EdgeCrossesRay(points[i], points.AtModulo(i + 1), point) ? 1 : 0)
            .Reduce(0, (acc, c) => acc + c)
            .IsOdd;
```
